verdict.rationale: Smooth documents a broad REST API covering task runs, list and cancel, persistent sessions, events (goto, extract, evaluate_js, close), custom tools, structured output, profiles and proxies. That makes its core functions programmatic, but no evidence confirms that every UI capability is exposed through the API. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of account, billing and profile management, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Smooth API enables programmatic browser automation through REST endpoints. You can run AI-powered tasks, create interactive browser sessions, and extend agent capabilities with custom tools.
List all tasks for the authenticated user.
Cancel a running task by its ID.
Send an event to a running task.
